evidence: SOURCE: task/solution/solve.sh is ASCII, LF-only (cat -A shows no ^M; grep for \r over solution/ finds nothing), shebang '#!/bin/bash' line 1, 'set -euo pipefail' line 2, `bash -n` OK. It writes only to /app: 'mkdir -p /app' (l3), 'cp -a "$(dirname "$0")/app/." /app/' (l35), 'rm -f -- "$database_path" ...-wal ...-shm' (l36) where database_path is realpath of ${DB_PATH:-/app/app.db} and is forced under /app (l5-9). No writes to /tests, /logs/verifier or /solution; no pkill, no NODE_ENV, no nproc, no npm/pip install (grep). Its extra node heredoc (l12-34) only reads /proc to refuse resetting a database another process holds open; it exits immediately when no DB files exist (l16), i.e. on every fresh Oracle install. Superset of template solve.sh (same mkdir+cp), task-specific additions only. APP CONTRACT: server.js -> src/index.js -> bootstrap.start: http listener on Number(process.env.PORT || 3000) on 0.0.0.0 (bootstrap.js:43); /api/health and /health answered before/without DB (bootstrap.js:20-24) matching brief 'GET /api/health ... never touches the database'; DB work in a worker thread given {...process.env, PORT:'0'} so DB_PATH/NODE_PATH propagate (bootstrap.js:45). db.js:9 'process.env.DB_PATH || path.join(__dirname, '..', 'app.db')' = /app/app.db default, honours DB_PATH, mkdirs parent (l19). Seeding idempotent: seedIfEmpty returns when users COUNT>0 (db.js:62), single transaction (l65). Self-contained: seed read from src/seed_data.json beside the module (db.js:10), byte-identical to environment/assets/seed_data.json (sha256 a1c65c80...), so no runtime /assets or /instructions read (grep finds only a descriptive string inside the seed JSON); only express and better-sqlite3 required, both preinstalled globally in environment/Dockerfile:9-12 at 5.1.0/12.4.1 matching package.json; all paths __dirname-based so the unknown cwd of test.sh's launch does not matter. test.sh:97-111 launches 'node /app/server.js' (or /tmp/submission copy) with env -i PATH, NODE_PATH, HOME, PORT=3000, DB_PATH=/app/app.db (or copy) as uid 65534 - every assumption is met by the reference. RUNTIME (hashes verified equal to the frozen bytes and the raw-evidence-index): workspace.cjs:16 spawns 'node /app/server.js' with env {PATH, HOME:/tmp, NODE_PATH:/usr/local/lib/node_modules, PORT:3000, DB_PATH:/tmp/hireops-workspace.db}, cwd /tmp; results/workspace.json records all groups passed including 'restart keeps jobs, cards, order, messages and activity without reseeding; live updates resume' (workspace.cjs:426-434, SIGTERM + relaunch over same DB with deepEqual of applications/activity); server.log shows two '[hireops] listening on 3000' lines. This evidences non-default DB_PATH honoured, NODE_PATH resolution inside the worker, and idempotent reseed. LOCAL DRY RUN (scratchpad r19, path-rewritten copy of solve.sh via sed on absolute /app only, Git Bash + node v24): fresh install exit 0 and produced exactly the 11 solution/app files with no app.db; DB_PATH=/tmp/x.db -> exit 1 'must be under /app' (guard works); reinstall-with-existing-db path could not be exercised on Windows (no /proc). WEAK/ALTERNATIVE PROBES: a golden that read /assets at runtime, used cwd-relative DB, or reseeded on each start would violate this row - none applies. A conforming agent submission is unaffected by this row (solve.sh only installs the reference). RISKS (not defects): (1) solve.sh itself has not been measured executing inside the Linux agent image, and no Oracle/test.sh-launched verifier run exists for these bytes (raw-evidence-index scope: 'Full configured grading/workload ... and Oracle/target scores are absent'); the scripted run populated /app by an unrecorded method and spawned node directly rather than via test.sh's setpriv/env -i path. (2) Latent P3: on a re-install where DB files exist and solve.sh runs as non-root, readdirSync('/proc/<pid>/fd') on another user's process raises EACCES, which the heredoc rethrows (l20-23), aborting solve.sh; also solve.sh aborts if DB_PATH is set outside /app at solve time. Neither occurs on a fresh root Oracle install with no DB_PATH in task.toml [environment].
